rules.sourceSection: Appendix 6, modified-file attribute and lifecycle examples

rules.applicableScope: Resolve once against the containing XML; retain selected sequence, backbone and fragment.
rules.implementationNote: P2-04 resolves once relative to the containing XML; exact sequence/backbone/fragment, query/scheme/escape/future rejection and explicit selection only. Windows positive and negative tests passed; no external-tool qualification is claimed.

rules.sourceSection: Appendix 6, modified-file attribute and lifecycle examples
rules.title: Historical XML and target leaf exist
rules.applicableScope: Resolve the exact XML ID within the explicit history baseline, including href-free delete operations.
rules.implementationNote: P2-04 distinguishes missing history/XML/ID, duplicate/non-leaf IDs, uninspected or invalid XML, and missing historical content; href-free delete is included. Missing prerequisites remain NotEvaluated, never a fallback match.

rules.sourceSection: Appendix 6, Operation Attribute; examples of replace, append and delete
rules.title: Target effectiveness and operation chains
rules.applicableScope: Evaluate target effectiveness, replacement/deletion chains, append and same-sequence combinations against pinned rules.
rules.implementationNote: P2-04 replays simple replace/append/delete against pre-sequence states. Inactive targets fail; unresolved historical effects propagate. Conflicting same-sequence operations, cycles and further append-branch operations remain NotEvaluated pending P3 policy.

rules.sourceSection: nodeIdentity; identities.LeafAddress; historyBaseline
rules.title: Historical target has compatible business context

rules.sourceSection: Appendix 2, Links; Appendix 6, xlink:href attribute

rules.sourceSection: Appendix 2, Checksums; Appendix 5, Security

rules.implementationNote: Declared MD5 is compared with reverified captured physical bytes, including historical payloads and regional XML; missing files remain unresolved. Delete checksum semantics are checked by lifecycle rules.

rules.sourceSection: Appendix 5, Security
rules.title: index-md5.txt matches the exact index.xml bytes
rules.applicableScope: The sequence root checksum file and actual ICH index bytes.
rules.implementationNote: Checks checksum-file presence, bounded ASCII MD5 syntax and the actual captured index.xml MD5; positive four-sequence and physical-corruption cases execute independently of the writer.

rules.sourceSection: Appendix 2, Directory Structure; Appendix 3; Appendix 4

rules.sourceSection: Appendix 2, pp. 2-3 to 2-4; Appendix 3, Folder and File Naming Conventions

rules.applicableScope: Distinguish ICH recommendations and each region's verified mandatory limits.
rules.implementationNote: Independent captured-path checks implement pinned ICH lowercase tokens, one extension, 64-character names and 230-character paths. Regional limits/exceptions and acceptance remain unqualified; recommended directory spellings are not mandatory.

rules.sourceSection: Appendix 7, Specification for Submission Formats, PDF

rules.applicableScope: Every delivered PDF; parse errors and unsupported inspection conditions must remain explicit.
rules.implementationNote: Every selected current/history PDF is inspected with PdfPig 0.1.15 strict parsing, bounded navigation and cooperative cancellation. Parse failures and unknown conditions remain explicit. Hard parser process isolation and external qualification remain pending.

rules.sourceSection: Appendix 5, Security; Appendix 7, Security
rules.title: PDF encryption and permissions allow review

rules.sourceSection: Appendix 7, Hypertext Linking and Bookmarks; Page Numbering

rules.applicableScope: Selected-profile navigation rules for each document and explicit unsupported conditions.
rules.implementationNote: Bounded raw outline traversal preserves destinations and reports the four-level recommendation without a hard failure. TOC/bookmark correspondence, page labels and initial-view consistency remain unevaluated.

rules.sourceSection: Appendix 7, Hypertext Linking and Bookmarks

rules.implementationNote: Raw GoTo/GoToR/URI, outlines, OpenAction and named destination tables resolve against the explicit capture set with exact page/name checks. Literal file specifications and once-decoded URIs are distinct. Unknown/chained/additional actions and unreadable targets remain unevaluated; external URLs are never fetched.

M1 2.6 Tables 2/3: efficacy, CMC, labeling and REMS supplements with application subtype require an explicit nonblank effective-date type. Each application is evaluated independently; unknown or ambiguous applicability remains NotEvaluated. Presence only; dictionary validity belongs to 2013.
rules.implementationNote: Requires archived fda-m1-conditional-v1 policy, exact catalog source authorization and pinned official bytes. Missing resources yield NotEvaluated. DTD prerequisites and Formal qualification remain in force.

rules.sourceSection: FDA eCTD Validation Criteria 4.7, p. 53, error 2045; official severity Medium; effective 2015-06-15
rules.title: Invalid form type for eCTD location
rules.applicableScope: US M1 DTD 3.3, bound selection date on or after 2015-06-15. M1 2.6 Table 10: forms directly under administrative submission-information allow only Form FDA 1571 and Form FDA 356h. Missing form types remain NotEvaluated; this does not claim all M1 placement or patent form rules.
rules.implementationNote: Requires archived fda-m1-conditional-v1 policy, exact catalog source authorization and pinned official bytes. Missing resources yield NotEvaluated. DTD prerequisites and Formal qualification remain in force.

rules.sourceSection: M1 2.6 Tables 2/3, PDF pages 11/12; project mapping, no FDA error-number attribution
rules.title: Supplement effective type combination
rules.applicableScope: Bound US M1 supplement/application inputs and exact archived combination policy; selection date from 2015-06-15
rules.implementationNote: Each application evaluated independently; missing/ambiguous or unauthorized mapping is NotEvaluated; old catalogs do not gain this project rule

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 24, error 1519; effective 2008-03-10
rules.title: Application number does not match the folder name
rules.applicableScope: Compare the single file-owning application number to an observed six-digit application directory; missing or unsupported directory naming is NotEvaluated. No prefix stripping or database identity substitution.
rules.implementationNote: Exact pinned FDA source and bound date required. Source layout is input-digest bound for new captures; legacy captures remain readable without fabricating evidence. DTD and full regional qualification remain separate.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 28, error 1714; effective 2008-03-10
rules.title: Sequence number does not match the folder name
rules.applicableScope: Compare the single file-owning XML sequence to the observed four-digit source directory; an explicitly selected root-only ZIP is not physical directory evidence.
rules.implementationNote: Exact pinned FDA source and bound date required. Source layout is input-digest bound for new captures; legacy captures remain readable without fabricating evidence. DTD and full regional qualification remain separate.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 49, error 2033; effective 2015-06-15
rules.title: Different sequence numbers are referenced for the same application number
rules.applicableScope: Within a grouped M1, the same primary application type and six-digit number must use the same four-digit sequence across regulatory activities; ambiguous identities are NotEvaluated.
rules.implementationNote: Exact pinned FDA source and bound date required. Source layout is input-digest bound for new captures; legacy captures remain readable without fabricating evidence. DTD and full regional qualification remain separate.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 11, error 1221; effective 2008-03-10
rules.title: File name exceeds maximum length (64 characters) per eCTD specification
rules.applicableScope: Captured target-sequence filenames including extensions; independent of XML parsing. Historical inputs are not reclassified by this current rule. Exact archived FDA source and bound selection date required.
rules.implementationNote: Official Low severity retained as Info. Filename checks do not imply format/type validity or full regulatory qualification.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 13, error 1298; effective 2013-04-30
rules.title: File does not contain a file extension
rules.applicableScope: Captured target-sequence filenames including extensions; independent of XML parsing. Historical inputs are not reclassified by this current rule. Exact archived FDA source and bound selection date required.
rules.implementationNote: Official Medium severity retained as Warning. Filename checks do not imply format/type validity or full regulatory qualification.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 13, error 1276; effective 2008-03-10
rules.title: Leaf element title leads or ends with a space
rules.applicableScope: Original target-sequence leaf title elements; leading/trailing ASCII space and missing/nonblank title checks. Duplicate/complex title structure, incomplete parsing or exhausted finding budget remain NotEvaluated. Historical inputs retain their own rules.
rules.implementationNote: Exact archived official source and bound selection date required; no current-resource substitution or formal qualification.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 13, error 1289; effective 2008-03-10
rules.title: Omitted leaf element title
rules.applicableScope: Original target-sequence leaf title elements; leading/trailing ASCII space and missing/nonblank title checks. Duplicate/complex title structure, incomplete parsing or exhausted finding budget remain NotEvaluated. Historical inputs retain their own rules.
rules.implementationNote: Exact archived official source and bound selection date required; no current-resource substitution or formal qualification.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 6, error 1034; effective 2008-03-10
rules.title: Invalid leaf element operation
rules.applicableScope: Explicit operation presence in captured target ICH and US leaf elements; missing, blank or defaulted values fail. Unknown explicit values and incomplete parsing remain NotEvaluated; DTD and lifecycle validity are separate.
rules.implementationNote: Official Medium maps to Warning. Exact archived original, provenance and selection date required; no guessed new operation or full regulatory qualification.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 11, error 1204; effective 2008-03-10
rules.title: File name contains invalid characters: tilde(~), forward slash(/), backslash(\), colon(:), asterisk(*), question mark(?), single quote('), double quote(") less than(<), greater than(>), pipe(|), or space( )
rules.applicableScope: Actual captured target-sequence filenames, without URI decoding, against the explicit FDA forbidden-character set. Nonportable names refused by input capture never produce a passing FDA result; their rejection remains an input prerequisite.
rules.implementationNote: Official Low maps to Info. Explicit archived original/provenance and bound selection date required. Does not classify raw slash separators as filename characters or equate safe path capture with FDA acceptance.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 15, error 1322; effective 2013-04-30
rules.title: Folder contains no files or sub folders
rules.applicableScope: Captured target-sequence directories containing neither files nor subfolders. Parent folders with child directories are not empty. Surrounding inputs are not silently adopted; directory findings have no downloadable file address.
rules.implementationNote: Official Low maps to Info. Exact archived original/provenance and selection date required. Independent directory/ZIP capture binds the observed empty-directory inventory.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 4, error 2; effective 2017-04-02
rules.title: eCTD submission missing us-regional.xml file
rules.applicableScope: Exact target-sequence m1/us/us-regional.xml file presence. Historical, surrounding, wrong-case and wrong-path files or directories do not satisfy this check; XML content validity is assessed separately.
rules.implementationNote: Official High maps to Error. Exact archived original/provenance and explicit selection date required. Reads the reverified captured target inventory and shares the file-stage finding budget.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 7, error 1051; effective 2008-03-10
rules.title: Extraneous leaf element path
rules.applicableScope: Nonempty xlink:href on an explicitly delete target leaf. Only target backbones are assessed; unknown or defaulted operations and incomplete XML cannot establish a pass.
rules.implementationNote: Official Medium maps to Warning. Exact archived source and explicit selection date required. Path values remain undecoded and located in the owning backbone; known failures take precedence over incomplete coverage.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 7, error 1068; effective 2008-03-10
rules.title: Extraneous modified leaf element path
rules.applicableScope: Nonempty modified-file on an explicitly new target leaf. Only target backbones are assessed; unknown or defaulted operations and incomplete XML cannot establish a pass.
rules.implementationNote: Official Medium maps to Warning. Exact archived source and explicit selection date required. Path values remain undecoded and located in the owning backbone; known failures take precedence over incomplete coverage.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 9, error 1136; effective 2008-03-10
rules.title: Omitted leaf element path
rules.applicableScope: Target backbone content leaves with an explicit new, append or replace operation require a nonblank XLink href.
rules.implementationNote: Missing or blank content path only. Presence does not establish path validity, file existence or history resolution. Delete does not deliver content.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 10, error 1153, effective 2008-03-10
rules.title: Missing modified file
rules.applicableScope: Supplied modified-file references on target sequence leaves, resolved against the explicitly selected application sequences.
rules.implementationNote: An absent file in a selected sequence or a missing leaf in a completely read backbone establishes failure. Missing history, unread backbones and ambiguous references remain unevaluated. Lookup is relative to captured bytes.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 11, error 1170, effective 2008-03-10
rules.title: Omitted leaf element modified file path
rules.applicableScope: Target sequence leaves with an explicit replace, append or delete operation.
rules.implementationNote: The unqualified modified-file attribute must contain a nonblank path for these operations.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 12, error 1238, effective 2008-03-10
rules.title: File size exceeds maximum limit (400 MB)
rules.applicableScope: Captured files in the selected target sequence, measured in uncompressed bytes.
rules.implementationNote: The general size screen covers lengths up to 400000000 bytes and reports declared PDFs with a PDF header above 419430400 bytes. The intervening byte range and other large file types require further assessment. Dataset applicability and effective-date qualification remain open.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 12, error 1255. FDA Specifications for File Format Types Using eCTD Specifications v9.3 pp. 3-7.
rules.title: Invalid file extension
rules.applicableScope: Content leaves in the target ICH backbone and the captured files they reference in the target sequence.
rules.implementationNote: Selected module-level rows in the archived FDA format revision 9.3 for M2 through M5. Regional sections, additional formats, permissible uses and historical versions require further assessment.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 14, error 1306. ICH eCTD v3.2 Q&A 36 item 13.
rules.title: No leaf element for file
rules.applicableScope: Captured target module folders m1 through m5 excluding nested util directories.
rules.implementationNote: Resolves target ICH and regional leaf references to exact logical file paths after complete backbone capture.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 14, error 1314. ICH eCTD Q&A 51.
rules.title: Non-required file exists
rules.applicableScope: Files in the selected target sequence's util folder.
rules.implementationNote: Recognizes pinned utility paths and bytes, including other regional assets, and locates Finder metadata. Additional regional and miscellaneous file classifications require further assessment.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 8, error 1111
rules.title: More than one version of the us-regional.xml file exists
rules.applicableScope: US regional backbone files and ICH M1 regional references in the captured target sequence.
rules.implementationNote: Counts physical us-regional.xml files and regional references independently. Known duplicates are retained when the other observation is incomplete.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 9, error 1119. ICH eCTD 3.2.2 Appendix 6 p. 6-2 and Q&A 36 items 2, 6 and 8.
rules.title: Missing required file
rules.applicableScope: Required ICH backbone DTD and observed conditional STF utility references in the selected target sequence.
rules.implementationNote: Checks ICH main DTD and observed STF 2.2 DTD, declared local stylesheet, and valid-values dependency proven by the supported stylesheet and archived sources. Creation-time ICH stylesheets, historical support variants and unresolved conditional discovery remain unqualified; US M1 3.3 website support references are not universally required as local utilities.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 9, error 1130. ICH Q&A 36 items 2, 6 and 8.
rules.title: Required file checksum value in the util folder must match the expected checksum
rules.applicableScope: Delivered main ICH DTD and recognized conditional STF utilities in the target sequence.
rules.implementationNote: Compares ICH main DTD, identified STF DTD 2.2 and stylesheet 2.3 with archived published MD5 values, and recognizes exact valid-values 6.0 bytes using the explicitly versioned ICH webpage checksum. Unknown stylesheet/valid-values versions remain NotEvaluated, not corrupt current versions. Creation-time ICH stylesheets and historical/other support variants remain unqualified.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 6, error 1038
rules.title: Application form and cover letter should be New
rules.applicableScope: Application form and cover letter leaves of the target US regional backbone.
rules.implementationNote: Locates non-new operations on form and cover letter leaves. Replacements require evidence of the corrective-document exception.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 15, error 1323. ICH Q&A 36 item 12.
rules.title: No file for leaf element
rules.applicableScope: Target ICH and US regional backbone leaf file references within the explicitly captured sequence set.
rules.implementationNote: Checks exact referenced file existence. Unavailable history and unresolved paths remain unevaluated; regional permission to reuse files across sequences is a separate check.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 16, error 1344
rules.title: Attribute value leads or ends with a space
rules.applicableScope: Explicit attributes in target ICH and US regional backbones and discovered STF documents, before DTD type normalization.
rules.implementationNote: Checks XML-decoded explicit values for leading or trailing U+0020 in target backbones and discovered STF documents. DTD defaults are excluded; missing raw values, incomplete discovery and unread documents remain unevaluated. Other XML scopes require further qualification.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 16, error 1357; pinned ICH DTD heading declarations; STF specification 2.6.1 pp. 5-7
rules.title: Required attribute value omitted in M2 - M5
rules.applicableScope: Target ICH M2.3.S, M3.2.S, M2.7.3 and M5.3.5 heading attributes, and STF categories bound to actual ICH section references.
rules.implementationNote: Checks required heading substance/manufacturer/indication and known STF species/route-of-admin/type-of-control categories using actual target index references and exact heading ancestry. Shared STF references union requirements. Duration applicability, regional category variants, missing placement and incomplete discovery remain unevaluated; complete STF attribute qualification remains open.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 17, error 1362; STF specification 2.6.1 pp. 5-7
rules.title: An attribute appears multiple times in the stf.xml file
rules.applicableScope: Known study-identifier category declarations within each target STF document.
rules.implementationNote: Detects repeated species, route-of-admin and type-of-control categories for realm ich and duration for realm us, without merging distinct STF documents. Unknown category/realm and other business-attribute scopes remain unqualified; file-tags and properties are not study categories.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 17, error 1368; pinned ICH DTD standard heading declarations; STF specification 2.6.1 pp. 5-7
rules.title: Extraneous attribute
rules.applicableScope: Explicit attributes on standard target ICH heading chains and known STF study categories bound to actual target section references.
rules.implementationNote: Checks standard ICH heading attributes and known STF categories against the union of actual qualified section references. Incomplete placement sets cannot prove extraneous categories; unknown realms and duration outside qualified examples remain unevaluated. Regional, leaf, extension and other STF attribute scopes remain unqualified.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 18, error 1374; ICH specification 3.2.2 sections 2-2 and 6-2
rules.title: Checksum value must match the actual checksum
rules.applicableScope: Valid MD5 declarations on target ICH/US backbone leaves and in target index-md5.txt.
rules.implementationNote: Compares valid MD5 values with captured bytes, including referenced STF files and explicitly supplied history. MD5 algorithm names are case-insensitive without trimming. Fixed ICH/US DTDs declare checksums on leaves; STF has no internal checksum attribute. Unavailable files and invalid comparison evidence remain unevaluated.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 18, error 1391
rules.title: Invalid checksum formatting in index-md5.txt
rules.applicableScope: Target sequence index-md5.txt byte format.
rules.implementationNote: Requires exactly 32 ASCII hexadecimal bytes, with no whitespace or encoding marker. Missing or unreadable target files remain unevaluated; checksum matching is separate.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 19, error 1408; ICH specification 3.2.2 section 6-10
rules.title: Invalid checksum type
rules.applicableScope: Explicit checksum-type attributes of target ICH and US regional backbone leaves.
rules.implementationNote: Accepts MD5 algorithm names case-insensitively without trimming on target ICH/US leaves, including leaves referencing STF files. Fixed STF DTD has no internal checksum-type attribute. Missing declarations and unread backbones remain unevaluated.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 19, error 1425; ICH specification 3.2.2 sections 6-4 and 6-10
rules.title: Omitted checksum value
rules.applicableScope: Target ICH/US backbone leaves explicitly using new, append or replace.
rules.implementationNote: Requires nonblank unqualified checksum values on content operations; delete is excluded. Unknown/default operations and unsupported XML scopes remain unevaluated; checksum format and matching are separate.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 19, error 1426; ICH specification 3.2.2 section 6-4
rules.title: Unexpected checksum value
rules.applicableScope: Target ICH/US backbone leaves explicitly using delete.
rules.implementationNote: Rejects any nonempty unqualified checksum on target ICH/US explicit delete leaves, including whitespace. Missing/empty values do not trigger this rule; DTD completeness remains separate. Fixed STF DTD has no internal checksum or operation attribute; STF lifecycle declarations are on backbone leaves. Unknown operations and unread backbones remain unevaluated.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 4, error 3
rules.title: Single file submission
rules.applicableScope: Explicit submission input role, including preflight inputs without a sequence backbone.
rules.implementationNote: Distinguishes a directly supplied file from a directory or valid ZIP container; one member in a container is not a single-file submission. Preflight freezes role and complete stable input inventory.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 20, error 1442; fixed ICH DTD root dtd-version declaration
rules.title: Omitted DTD version in index.xml
rules.applicableScope: Explicit dtd-version declaration on the target index.xml root.
rules.implementationNote: Distinguishes explicit root attributes from DTD defaults. A retained complete root attribute set supports presence or omission even if later XML content fails. Missing or ambiguous root facts and unsupported explicit versions remain unevaluated; historical roots are excluded.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 20, error 1445; fixed US M1 3.3 DTD root declaration
rules.title: Omitted DTD version in US regional XML
rules.applicableScope: Explicit dtd-version declarations on all target selected US regional roots.
rules.implementationNote: Checks every selected regional root, including delivered default and referenced custom files. DTD defaults do not supply explicit versions. Known omissions survive other unread evidence; incomplete selection or unavailable roots cannot pass. Historical and unselected files are excluded.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 21, error 1476; fixed ICH/US node-extension declarations
rules.title: Node-extension exists
rules.applicableScope: Unqualified node-extension elements in target ICH and selected US regional backbones.
rules.implementationNote: Reports every retained target extension element, including nested and optional-ID extensions, independently of lifecycle identity. Known elements survive later read failures; incomplete XML selection cannot prove absence. Foreign namespaces and historical documents are excluded; fixed STF DTD has no node-extension element.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 22, error 1478; ICH/US node-extension content declarations
rules.title: Node-extension does not have a title
rules.applicableScope: Direct title-element presence on target ICH/US node-extension elements.
rules.implementationNote: Checks exact unqualified direct title elements, not descendant leaf/nested titles. Empty or whitespace titles still exist; duplicate/order validity remains separate. Incomplete documents cannot prove title absence; known failures from complete documents survive other unread scope.

rules.sourceSection: FDA Validation Criteria 4.7 p. 4, error 4
rules.title: Submission containing no files
rules.applicableScope: Complete stable inventory of the explicitly selected submission input.
rules.implementationNote: Empty directory and valid ZIP containers fail only after complete safe scanning and stability verification. Directory entries do not count as files; zero-byte files do. Invalid, changed or interrupted inputs do not establish absence.
